features.description: Preserve declared function arity on inline test cases and refuse nullary, one-element tuple, and mismatched tuple shapes during collection with positioned diagnostics.
acceptance_criteria: Every collected inline test carries enough declaration information to distinguish unary tuple input from multi-argument input.
Invalid shape or arity rows are not appended as executable tests.
Mismatch diagnostics name declared arity, supplied count, function, and source location.
Named tests and inline properties retain existing behavior.

features.description: Build inline and cluster harness calls from declared arity, return construction errors instead of panicking, and wrap executor failures once.
acceptance_criteria: Unary tuple input builds App(f, [Tuple(a, b)]).
N-ary input builds one App with N direct arguments and never curries.
Inline and cluster harness builders pass the identical-row unary-versus-binary disambiguation tests.
Malformed internal shapes return errors and executor output has one harness context prefix.

features.description: Refuse flat multi-argument rows with the approved nested-form hint and recover without PAR_INFINITE_LOOP cascades.
acceptance_criteria: tests [(1, 2, 3)] is refused with a hint to use ((a, b), expected).
The malformed row emits no PAR_INFINITE_LOOP diagnostic.
Parser recovery is pinned across multiple rows and following declarations.
Valid scalar and nested rows retain their AST shapes.

features.description: Verify tuple-valued unary, multi-argument, malformed-row, examples, and JSON behavior through the public test path and full regression suite.
acceptance_criteria: Direct and nested-match unary tuple rows pass end to end.
The existing three-argument example remains passing.
Flat and wrong-arity rows never surface as runtime no pattern matched failures.
JSON diagnostics are actionable and positioned, and make test/fmt/lint/check-boundaries pass.
